readings: Compute each rating's average film length, ignoring NULL lengths. Let the first average be the unweighted mean of the five ratings' average lengths. Keep the ratings whose average length is above that first average. From those, keep only the ratings whose average length is above the mean of the average lengths of the ratings that passed the first cut. Return one row with: (a) the mean of the remaining ratings' average lengths, (b) the mean amount by which the remaining ratings' averages exceed the first average, and (c) the mean amount by which they exceed the mean of the ratings that passed the first cut. No rounding.

Compute each rating's average film length, ignoring NULL lengths. Let the first average be the overall average length across all films with a non-NULL length, so ratings with more films weigh more. Keep the ratings whose average length is above that overall average. From those, keep only the ratings whose average length is above the mean of the average lengths of the ratings that passed the first cut. Return one row with: (a) the mean of the remaining ratings' average lengths, (b) the mean amount by which the remaining ratings' averages exceed the overall film average, and (c) the mean amount by which they exceed the mean of the ratings that passed the first cut. No rounding.

Compute each rating's average film length, ignoring NULL lengths. Let the first average be the overall average length across all films with a non-NULL length. Keep the ratings whose average length is above that overall average. From those, keep only the ratings whose average length is above the unweighted mean of all five ratings' average lengths. Return one row with: (a) the mean of the remaining ratings' average lengths, (b) the mean amount by which the remaining ratings' averages exceed the overall film average, and (c) the mean amount by which they exceed the mean of the ratings that passed the first cut. No rounding.
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating
),
m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM r),
p1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a FROM r, m1 WHERE r.a > m1.m),
m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM p1),
p2 AS (SELECT p1.rating, p1.a FROM p1, m2 WHERE p1.a > m2.m)
SELECT AVG(p2.a) AS mean_remaining,
       AVG(p2.a - m1.m) AS mean_excess_over_first,
       AVG(p2.a - m2.m) AS mean_excess_over_second
FROM p2, m1, m2;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS overall_avg
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
s1 AS (
  SELECT r.rating, r.avg_len
  FROM r, o
  WHERE r.avg_len > o.overall_avg
),
m1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS mean_first
  FROM s1
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_len
  FROM s1, m1
  WHERE s1.avg_len > m1.mean_first
)
SELECT
  AVG(s2.avg_len) AS mean_avg_length,
  AVG(s2.avg_len - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(s2.avg_len - m1.mean_first) AS mean_excess_over_first_cut_mean
FROM s2, o, m1;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS overall FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
a AS (
  SELECT r.rating, r.avg_len
  FROM r, o
  WHERE r.avg_len > o.overall
),
m AS (
  SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_len) FROM r) AS mean_all,
         (SELECT AVG(avg_len) FROM a) AS mean_a
),
b AS (
  SELECT a.rating, a.avg_len
  FROM a, m
  WHERE a.avg_len > m.mean_all
)
SELECT AVG(b.avg_len) AS mean_remaining,
       AVG(b.avg_len - o.overall) AS mean_excess_over_overall,
       AVG(b.avg_len - m.mean_a) AS mean_excess_over_first_cut_mean
FROM b, o, m;
